info.description:
Documentation for the [`{ json:api }`](https://jsonapi.org) API for using [nvp.gg](https://nvp.gg)

------------------------

Unauthenticated users are limited to 1 request per minute.

Authenticated users are limited to 100 requests per minute.

All endpoints use the `application/vnd.api+json` MIME type for both `Accept` and `Content-Type` headers.

The links endpoints accept an API key via `Authorization: Bearer nvp_...` — create one in the dashboard under "API Keys". Keys carry scopes (`links:read`, `links:write`) and are pinned to the account they were created in. Everything else requires the first-party browser session.

apiKey.description: An API key (`nvp_...`), created in the dashboard under "API Keys". Keys are scoped (`links:read`, `links:write`) and pinned to one account.

Any.description: Any JSON object not defined as schema

get.description: Lists the account's links. Accepts an API key with the `links:read` scope. Supports `sort` (e.g. `-createdAt`), `page[number]`/`page[size]`, and `fields[link]` sparse fieldsets.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The account to operate on — any account you belong to. Defaults to your personal account.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated relationship paths to sideload into `included` (e.g. `ownedBy,createdBy`). Unknown paths are a 400.

post.description: Creates a short link on the account. Body is a { json:api } resource document: { "data": { "type": "link", "attributes": { "original": "https://...", "domain": "optional-custom-domain" } } }. Accepts an API key with the `links:write` scope.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The account to operate on — any account you belong to. Defaults to your personal account.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated relationship paths to sideload into `included` (e.g. `ownedBy,createdBy`). Unknown paths are a 400.

get.description: Shows one of the account's links. Accepts an API key with the `links:read` scope.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The account to operate on — any account you belong to. Defaults to your personal account.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated relationship paths to sideload into `included` (e.g. `ownedBy,createdBy`). Unknown paths are a 400.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The account to operate on — any account you belong to. Defaults to your personal account.

delete.description: Deletes one of the account's links. 404 when there is nothing to delete. Accepts an API key with the `links:write` scope.

get.description: Lists recorded visits ("clicks") for one of the account's links, most recent first. Each visit records when it happened, the referrer, and the user agent. Accepts an API key with the `links:read` scope.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The account to operate on — any account you belong to. Defaults to your personal account.

post.description: Creates an additional (non-personal) account with you as admin. Body is a { json:api } resource document: { "data": { "type": "account", "attributes": { "name": "..." } } }. Gated by your personal account's plan: side-hobby 1, hobby 2, project 3, unpaid 0 (402 when full).

get.description: Shows your authenticated user's account. Other accounts are not visible. Billing details are not included here — see the billing endpoints.
Lists the members of an account you belong to.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated relationship paths to sideload into `included` (e.g. `user,account.admin`). Unknown paths are a 400.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated relationship paths to sideload into `included` (e.g. `account.admin`). Unknown paths are a 400.

post.description: Creates a shareable invitation link (account admins only). Gated by the plan's teammate limit (402 when full). The response's acceptUrl is the link to share.
Accepts an invitation token, joining its account as a member. Body: { "token": "..." }. Idempotent for existing members.

delete.description: Revokes a pending invitation (account admins only).

Admins may remove anyone; members may remove themselves (leave). The account owner cannot be removed. When the removed member was active in that account, their active account falls back to their personal one.

get.description: Lists your API keys for the account, with the account-wide quota in `meta` ({ limit, used, remaining }). Key secrets are never included. Managing keys requires the browser session — a key cannot mint or revoke keys.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The account to operate on — any account you belong to. Defaults to your personal account.

post.description: Creates an API key on your membership in the account. Body: { "name": "...", "scopes": ["links:read", "links:write"], "expiresInDays": 90 } (expiresInDays optional — omit for a non-expiring key). Gated by the account plan's API key limit: hobby 1, project 3, others 0 (402 when full). The secret (the `token` attribute, `nvp_...`) is ONLY in this response — store it immediately. Use it as `Authorization: Bearer nvp_...` on the links endpoints.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The account to operate on — any account you belong to. Defaults to your personal account.

delete.description: Revokes one of your API keys. 404 when there is nothing to revoke.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The account to operate on — any account you belong to. Defaults to your personal account.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The account to operate on — any account you belong to. Defaults to your personal account.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated relationship paths to sideload into `included` (e.g. `account.admin`). Unknown paths are a 400.

post.description: Adds a custom domain for link creation (account admins only). Body is a { json:api } resource document: { "data": { "type": "custom-domain", "attributes": { "hostname": "links.example.com" } } }. Gated by the plan's domain limit (402 when full). Short links can then be created with a "domain" property.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The account to operate on — any account you belong to. Defaults to your personal account.

delete.description: Removes a custom domain (account admins only). Links on it stop resolving.

get.description: The account's plan, usage (links used/remaining this period), Stripe subscription state, and the available plans.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The account to operate on — any account you belong to. Defaults to your personal account.

post.description: Starts a subscription checkout for the account (account admins only). Body: { "plan": "side-hobby" | "hobby" | "project" }. Returns the Stripe-hosted checkout URL to redirect the browser to. 409 when a subscription is already active.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The account to operate on — any account you belong to. Defaults to your personal account.

post.description: Creates a Stripe billing-portal session for the account (account admins only) — plan changes and cancellation happen there. Returns the portal URL to redirect the browser to.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The account to operate on — any account you belong to. Defaults to your personal account.

get.description: Shows a user within your authenticated user's account. Other users are not visible.
